differences.cause: W538 (#603): AUTO-07p labels a fold of the cycles at point 93 (period 62.9, norm 0.42775, parameter 0.7080717), where xppautX at DS 0.025 labels none. The fold is real: with DS 0.0125 xppautX labels folds at parameter 0.7080724 and 0.7080721 (points 48 and 50), a pair 3e-7 apart inside one default step, which the sign test on stored points cannot see; AUTO-07p's step lands on one of them. A step-resolution limit of the continuation, not a wrong result; its fix would be a card on step-size control near a fold pair (docs/auto-references.md, W538).
